summary: Accessible markup lets everyone use the page, including people using a screen reader or only a keyboard. Give images the right alt text and connect every form field to its label and hints.
notes: The date image has alt text because it carries information. The divider line has alt="" so screen readers skip it.
aria-describedby="team-hint" points at the hint's id. A screen reader says "Team name, edit text, required, 3 to 20 letters."
<legend> is read before each radio button, so "New to coding" is heard as part of the Experience level question.
pitfall: Leaving alt off a decorative image instead of writing alt="". Without alt, screen readers read the file name or the whole data: URI.
